correctness.rationale: For all integers m,n>=2, positive rates and t>=0, an explicit three-eigenspace decomposition gives the cross-Dirac signed mass; a primal transport plan and dual Lipschitz potentials prove its exact transport cost. The classical Dirac-pair reduction and same-part decay give the global semigroup norm. Derivatives establish the iff contractivity regime, unique temporary-amplification time and exact peak. All limit cases at t=0 and long t are included. The independently optimized Kantorovich LP replay passed 60 finite configurations; it supplements but never replaces the analytic proof.

value.rationale: Determines the sharp all-time Lipschitz/W1 operator norm for a motivated infinite family of irreducible reversible weighted graph Markov semigroups, completely separates contractive and transiently expansive regimes, and calculates the unique worst-case transient peak. In contrast with merely estimating spectral gaps or coarse-curvature bounds, the exact nonexponential profile gives a quantitative benchmark for sharp transport mixing and weighted graph diffusion. No arbitrary fixed-size slicing is needed.
